headlines.title: Bill Gates says AI 'powerful enough' to cause 'a billion deaths'
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates calls for government safeguards to address the risks posed by artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Iran foreign minister says Iran prepared for war to resume, even if it becomes ‘doomsday’
headlines.description: Foreign Minister of Iran Abbas Araghchi tells Meet the Press that Iran is ready to “stand firm in the face of any aggression” amid reports that President Trump wants to resume bombing after the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Powerful storm brings major flooding and power outages across Northeast
headlines.description: A powerful, slow-moving storm creeping along the coast of the Northeast brought high winds that have caused power outages, while whipping up big waves and heavy rain. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports from the storm zone in New Jersey.

headlines.title: How an American teacher’s $5,000 donation helped turn a Chinese desert into a lush forest
headlines.description: Ronald Sakolsky couldn’t believe his eyes when he visited China’s Mu Us Desert for the first time in 26 years. “Seeing it with my own eyes, that was the biggest surprise,” he said.

headlines.title: Suspected terror attack thwarted near U.S. air base in U.K.
headlines.description: British police arrested several men on suspicion of terror and explosives offenses on Sunday and evacuated homes near an air base that the U.S. Air Force had been using to facilitate strikes on Iran. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend

headlines.description: Three years after the Oct. 7th attacks, the party is still divided on how to deal with Israel, Gaza and the Netanyahu government

headlines.title: Inside NBC News’ polling averages: Democrats enjoy biggest lead yet in the race for Congress
headlines.description: Meanwhile, President Donald Trump’s approval rating is at a low point for his second term.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Nor’easter unearths fragments of 19th century shipwreck on Nantucket
headlines.description: A local journalist spotted wreckage most likely belonging to the Warren Sawyer near where fragments believed to be from the doomed schooner were discovered in 2022.
